case.query:
MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.class, '')) CONTAINS 'graphitepressureabsent43zerox'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.name, '')) CONTAINS 'graphitepressureabsent43zerox'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS 'graphitepressureabsent43zerox'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS 'graphitepressureabsent43zerox'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS 'graphitepressureabsent43zerox'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) CONTAINS 'graphitepressureabsent43zerox'
RETURN DISTINCT n.class, n.name, n.caller_class, n.caller_name, n.callee_class, n.callee_name
LIMIT 200
